durability.writer: apply_mock.start_step/finish_step use SQLAlchemy transactions and row locks around the persisted JSON list. STARTED is committed before each phase action, then replaced with COMPLETED/FAILED.
durability.readback: The core success case disposes the original engine, opens a new Store on the same SQLite file, reads the exact ordered ten-item attempt list, then reads the same list through TestClient(create_app(...)) application detail.
durability.failure: The interrupted-contact case performs the real Locator.fill and then raises; after reopening the Store it observes prior completed phases and FILL_CONTACT:FAILED, application-attempt state REVIEW_REQUIRED, and no mock submission receipt.
durability.distinction: applications.trace is the older coarse state-transition list. The complete ten-phase evidence is application_attempts.steps, not a claim that all ten labels appear in applications.trace.
durability.optional_phase: UPLOAD_SUPPORTING_DOCUMENTS is an additive phase when supporting attachments exist; the original ten remain present in order.

privacy.current_writer: All start_step call arguments are fixed source literals; persisted attempt steps contain only a phase and status. The core success test excludes synthetic profile name, email, and answer text from the actual saved step list.
privacy.failure: The interrupted-contact test excludes profile name, email, and the injected private sentinel from persisted steps. finish_attempt maps exception types to safe codes without recording exception messages.
privacy.defense_in_depth: The mounted attempt-history endpoint allowlists phase/status pairs, returns 404 for a different profile, rejects POST with 405, hides hostile stored strings, and leaves audit row count unchanged in the selected executed supporting test.
privacy.scope_limit: Privacy conclusions concern trace/history fields and safe error codes. They do not assert that the full application response contains no authorized profile/documents data; the older application-detail attempts serializer is not claimed to sanitize arbitrary legacy-corrupted rows.

consumer_chain.connection: The mounted application details include MockRunControls and ApplicationAttemptHistory; legacy Attempts also renders selectedApp.attempts[].steps. UI execution is static source connection evidence here.
Calls the profile/application scoped mock-run route.
POST mock-run rejects non-FIXTURE mode and non-MOCK targets, checks profile ownership, and queues APPLY_MOCK. create_app mounts the read-only attempt-history router.
queue_mock_run asserts FIXTURE workspace, validates profile/application/request identity and input snapshot, and persists the APPLY_MOCK worker operation.
execute_operation handles APPLY_MOCK, validates request/resume binding, and invokes the same imported services.applications.mock_adapter.apply_mock function reviewed and exercised by the core tests.
The real Playwright browser implementation owns phase persistence; only allowlisted fixture HTTP requests continue. It is reachable from supported mounted API/worker code, not an orphan helper.
create_application_attempt_history_router is mounted by create_app and calls read_attempt_history with the profile/application scope.
